integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses the published scalar-unitary formula, its invertibility lemma, and standard disk-automorphism normal forms. No numerical experiment or external certificate is required for correctness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for the canonical normalized automorphisms from the focal parametrization, not for a general representation with additional outer factors.
It classifies preservation and dynamics of the scalar unitary circle; it does not prove that the star order alone defines that circle intrinsically.
title: Center-preserving order automorphisms of matrix partial isometries have Möbius boundary dynamics
